title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement:
Find a longest contiguous piece of a string that reads the same forwards and backwards.

Contract
- `text` is non-null and may be empty; it can contain any characters. Comparison is
  case-sensitive and exact (no skipping of spaces or punctuation).
- Return a palindromic substring of `text` whose length is the maximum possible. When several
  longest palindromes exist, any one of them is accepted. For an empty `text`, return `""`.

Examples
- `longestPalindrome("xabbay")` returns `"abba"`.
- `longestPalindrome("qrsr")` returns `"rsr"`.
- `longestPalindrome("ab")` returns `"a"` or `"b"`.
hints: Every palindrome mirrors around its middle. Think about what the middle can look like for odd and even lengths.
Treat each character, and each gap between two characters, as a possible center and grow outward while the two ends match; remember the best span.
Track only start and length, and extract the substring once at the end. Intended complexity: O(n^2) time and O(n) space, where n is the length of the text (the O(n) space is the returned substring).
inputSyntax: Input: one piece of text with no spaces, for example: xabbay
